cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I've approved looking after your dog during the kitchen repairs. Bring him after his walk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Overnight is approved. You may use my guest room so you can handle his breakfast while I sleep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stay, but can you do the six o'clock walk?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I authorize a six o'clock walk. I'll put the lead by the door and set your alarm; you may leave the planning entirely to me.

reason: Turn each care request into a granted arrangement whose interpretation shifts the inconvenient work back to the owner while A keeps managerial credit.
